# Exploratory high-dimensional outcomes: microbiome, untargeted proteomics, untargeted metabolomics

This section covers human milk components that were designated as exploratory outcomes: the milk microbiome (α-diversity and individual taxa), untargeted proteomics, and untargeted metabolomics.

```{r explor-setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
source(here::here("functions.R"))

keep_ate <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  if ("measure" %in% names(df)) df <- dplyr::filter(df, measure == "ATE")
  df
}

## Wrapper: read, filter to ATE, attach label_f, alias chi_pval/chi_pval_adj.
prep_explor <- function(rds_path) {
  df <- safe_readRDS(here::here(rds_path), label = basename(rds_path))
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  if ("res" %in% names(df)) df <- unnest_imic_results(df)
  df <- keep_ate(df)
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  if (!"label_f" %in% names(df))       df$label_f  <- df$biomarker
  if (!"pval" %in% names(df) && "chi_pval" %in% names(df))         df$pval     <- df$chi_pval
  if (!"pval_adj" %in% names(df) && "chi_pval_adj" %in% names(df)) df$pval_adj <- df$chi_pval_adj
  df
}
```

## Microbiome

### α-diversity

Effects on z-scored observed richness and Shannon diversity, pooled and then by randomized arm.

```{r microbiome-div-combined, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- prep_explor("results/microbiome_diversity_intervention_effects_results.RDS")
if (!is.null(df)) clean_tab(df, caption = "Pooled intervention vs. control.")
```

```{r microbiome-div-strat, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- prep_explor("results/microbiome_diversity_intervention_effects_results_arm_strat.RDS")
if (!is.null(df)) clean_tab(df, caption = "Each randomized arm vs. control. P and Q are from the joint test across a trial's arms, so they repeat for every arm.",
                            joint_test = TRUE)
```

### Individual microbial features

Per-taxon effects, pooled intervention vs. control.

```{r microbiome-vol-combined, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7, results='asis'}
df <- prep_explor("results/microbiome_intervention_effects_results.RDS")
if (!is.null(df)) {
  p <- volcano_capped(df, title = "Microbial features")
  print(htmltools::tagList(p, nice_dt(df %>% dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))),
          caption = "Per-taxon effects, pooled intervention vs. control.")))
}
```

## Untargeted proteomics

Per-protein effects in the dyads with proteomics, pooled intervention vs. control and then each randomized arm vs. control. ELICIT is not included because its proteome samples came only from the control and azithromycin arms.

```{r prot-vol, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7, results='asis'}
df <- prep_explor("results/adjusted_combined_arms_intervention_effects_proteomics_results_clean.RDS")
if (!is.null(df)) {
  p <- volcano_capped(df, title = "Untargeted proteome")
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    p,
    nice_dt(df %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("study","visit","contrast","label_f","biomarker",
                                                  "est","cil","ciu","pval","pval_adj","sig","sigFDR"))) %>%
              dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))),
            caption = "Per-protein effects, pooled intervention vs. control.")
  ))
}
```

```{r prot-armstrat, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Arm-by-arm per-protein effects; the article's protein counts for Mumta-LW come
## from the BEP arm without azithromycin (BEP+ExBf), so they are shown here.
dfa <- safe_readRDS(here::here("results/proteomics_intervention_effects_results_arm_strat.RDS"),
                    label = "proteomics_intervention_effects_results_arm_strat.RDS")
if (!is.null(dfa) && nrow(dfa)) {
  dfa <- .harmonize_factors(as.data.frame(dfa))
  n_tab <- dfa %>% dplyr::group_by(study, contrast) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), k = sum(pval_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  counts <- paste(sprintf("%s %s, %s of %s", n_tab$study, n_tab$contrast,
                          formatC(n_tab$k, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
                          formatC(n_tab$n, format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
                  collapse = "; ")
  nice_dt(dfa %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("study","visit","contrast","label_f","biomarker",
                                                "est","cil","ciu","pval","pval_adj","sigFDR"))) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))),
          caption = paste0("Per-protein effects, each randomized arm vs. control. Proteins with Q < 0.05: ",
                           counts, "."))
}
```

## Untargeted metabolomics

Per-feature effects, pooled intervention vs. control, across trials, visits, and ionization modes.

```{r met-vol, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7, results='asis'}
df <- prep_explor("results/adjusted_combined_arms_intervention_effects_untargeted_results_clean.RDS")
if (!is.null(df)) {
  p <- volcano_capped(df, n_show = 5000,
                      table_note = "the table lists the features with Q < 0.10",
                      title = "Untargeted metabolome")
  ## The full ~1M-row table is far too large to render as DT; expose the
  ## Q < 0.10 subset only.
  df_sig <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pval_adj), pval_adj < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    p,
    nice_dt(df_sig %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
      "study","visit","contrast","label_f","biomarker","est","cil","ciu",
      "pval","pval_adj","sig","sigFDR"))), page_length = 25,
      caption = sprintf("The %s features with Q < 0.10, of %s estimates.",
                        format(nrow(df_sig), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(df), big.mark = ",")))
  ))
}
```
